parameters.description:
A deliberately fake MCP server that requires a credential, used to exercise the platform's own token-injection path.

This is not a useful service. It points at UnitySVC's mock MCP server, whose `/mcp/private` namespace returns 401 when no `Authorization: Bearer` header arrives and 200 when one does — regardless of its value. That makes it the one service that can prove, end to end, that an enrolled customer's credential actually reaches an upstream MCP server: the tools appear only if the injection worked.

The credential carries a default, so the path is exercisable with no secret provisioned at all. Set MOCK_MCP_TOKEN to any value to override it.

It is listed so the machinery has a test target that does not depend on a third-party account. Enrol only if you are testing the platform.
